BIRD: Greater Sooty Owl
RATIONALE: The Greater Sooty Owl's strikingly dark, almost black, plumage perfectly embodies a "baleful" and mysterious aesthetic, aligning with the card's blue-black colors. As a supremely silent, nocturnal predator, its precise and deadly hunting skills strongly evoke the 'deathtouch' ability, while its nature as an owl connects naturally to the 'draw a card' wisdom and foresight. This species also directly relates to the "Strix" in the original card's name. wildlife photography
